long_summary: The document is a USPTO receipt for a Utility-Provisional Patent Application (Application Type: Utility-Provisional Application under 35 USC 111(b)) filed by HealthRate Inc. The application number is 63/707,441 with Patent Center #: 67575019. The receipt was generated on 10/15/2024 at 3:01:38 PM ET, Confirmation #: 1561, Attorney Docket #: 63/707,441. It was filed by Jeff Sage and lists the first named inventor as Tim Michaels. The correspondence address for HealthRate Inc is 701 S. Carson St Suite 200, Carson City, NV 89701 US. The total fee due at the time of filing was $120.00.
